    (Dagum('X', S(1)/3, S(1)/5, 2),   [0.5, 2.0, 7.0],     (0, oo)),
    (Erlang('X', 3, 2),        [0.4, 1.5, 4.0],            (0, oo)),
    (Frechet('X', S(4)/3, 1, 2), [2.5, 3.0, 9.0],          (2, oo)),
    (Gamma('X', S(7)/3, 2),    [0.5, 2.0, 6.0],            (0, oo)),
    (GammaInverse('X', S(5)/7, 2), [0.5, 1.5, 4.0],        (0, oo)),
    (Kumaraswamy('X', S(1)/123, 5), [0.1, S(1)/3, 0.9],   (0, 1)),

]
